organizations.publicNote: German record company. Grammophon and Polydor were record-label imprints and are represented separately from the corporate body.
Record-label imprint of Deutsche Grammophon-Aktiengesellschaft, printed as Grammophon on the linked German discs.
Record-label imprint of Deutsche Grammophon-Aktiengesellschaft, printed as Polydor on the linked German and export issues.

sources.fullCitation: Deutsche Nationalbibliothek. “Deutsche Grammophon-Aktiengesellschaft (Berlin).” Gemeinsame Normdatei, GND 1094330-4. Record modified 4 September 2024.
sources.title: GND authority record: Deutsche Grammophon-Aktiengesellschaft (Berlin)
sources.researchNote: The record gives the corporate body at Berlin, established 1900 and terminated 1940, with the variants Deutsche Grammophon AG (Berlin) and Grammophon-Aktiengesellschaft (Berlin). It states that a second Deutsche Grammophon-AG existed at Wahren near Leipzig in the 1930s, and names Grundstücksgesellschaft Markgrafenstraße Aktiengesellschaft in Liquidation as the succeeding body. Consulted through the machine-readable GND service at lobid.org.
